Name: Harvey wears a doctor uniform
Author: Eli0630
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Have you noticed that Maru wears a hospital uniform when she goes to work at the clinic? So why doesn't Harvey, the clinic owner, wear a hospital uniform? That's not very professional of him.
That's why I created a mod that adds that; now every time you enter Harvey's clinic, you'll see him in a white coat worthy of a doctor.
Yes, I know SCA does that, but this is NOT SCA🙄So pretend that no one but me came up with this wonderful idea🙄✨

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then paste Content Patcher into the mods folder and then this mod; it should work. 

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Harvey will wear a hospital uniform whenever he is at the clinic. 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
This mod requires:
- Content Patcher 
- SMAPI (Obviously)
